heading: Today
text: Areas of dense fog, and a stray morning shower, giving way to a mix of clouds and sunshine.  A few stray afternoon showers or a thunderstorm.  Highs in the 70s to low 80s.  Winds light, mainly northwest less than 10 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Partly cloudy.  Areas of dense valley fog forming. Lows in the upper 50s to mid 60s, warmest in the Champlain Valley.  Winds light and variable, turning to the south in the Champlain Valley near 10 mph.

heading: Saturday
text: Some areas of dense morning fog, then sunshine, mixing with increasing afternoon clouds.  Warm and muggy.  Highs in the upper 70s to mid 80s.  Winds becoming south near 10 mph, gusting to 20 mph near Lake Champlain.
